messages:
alyssa: Quick ask — for the upcoming benchmark launch we need an a11y-friendly variant and standard variant of the benchmark tiles. Deliverables: sparkline microtile (1200x628), serving-wins hero (1200x628), and a compact inbound routing sticker. Need alt-text and one-liner copy for social. target: assets ready by EOD Wed.
marco: Got it. Which frames should I clone for the a11y treatment? the 'latency vs cost' and 'serving wins' hero, right?
alyssa: Yep those two + an inbound sticker with the lead routing microcopy. Also add a small source note: "measurement vs baseline — internal tests."
jia: FYI legal: can we avoid absolute claims? e.g. "2x cheaper" might need qualifiers. Looping in @legal-ops.
legal-ops: Quick note: use qualifiers like "up to" or cite baseline. Example acceptable phrasing: "up to 2x lower per-token cost vs baseline" and add a tooltip/source line. Once copy updated we'll do final sign-off.
marco: Cool. @designbot can you export three variants per frame: default, a11y-high-contrast, a11y-large-type? Needed formats: PNG 1200x628 (social), PNG 600x314 (preview), and SVG for docs. Include separate Figma pages: /figma/bench/exports.
designbot: Export job queued by marco: file=figma://redwood/benchkit id=F123 frame=[sparkline-compact, serving-wins-hero, inbound-sticker] variants=[default,a11y-high-contrast,a11y-large-type] outputs=[png:1200x628,png:600x314,svg]. ETA ~10m.
sam: I'll write the alt-text and short social lines once I have the final exports. Alyssa drop one-liners please. :thumbsup:
alyssa: Copy drafts: 1) "Line chart comparing latency vs per-token cost; Redwood Inference reduces per-token cost by up to 30% vs baseline." 2) alt text for sparkline: "Line chart showing latency vs per-token cost across models; Redwood Inference appears lower on cost." 3) sticker microcopy: "Route leads • benchmark demo -> sales@redwood.ai"
lucy: A11y QA: for high-contrast variant ensure color contrast >= 4.5:1 for body text, >= 7:1 for small labels. Increase label font-size to 16px for small screens. Also include keyboard-focus outline for interactive docs.
marco: Will bump label to 16px on a11y-large-type and confirm contrast. Also will keep layer naming convention: sparkline-compact__a11y-hc, sparkline-compact__a11y-lt, etc.
legal-ops: After Marco updates copy to "up to 30%" and adds source note, we can clear. Please add small footnote: "based on internal benchmark tests, see docs."
marco: PR to Figma done and exports are in /figma/bench/exports/1766123456/ — files: sparkline-compact_default.png, sparkline-compact_a11y-hc.png, serving-wins-hero_a11y-lt.svg etc. @designbot confirmed.
designbot: Export complete. Links: https://figma.redwood/exports/1766123456/sparkline-compact_a11y-hc.png (public-preview).
sam: Alt-text and microcopy ready and pushed to marketing copy doc: https://docs.redwood/marketing/bench-copy. Alt-texts are short and follow a11y guidance.
alyssa: Timeline check — design/export done today, legal review by tomorrow 12:00, final assets to sales and web by Monday. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
marco: On it, will ping if anything blocks.
legal-ops: Leaving a note: when using "up to" please avoid implying typical performance; if you want median numbers include that language.
alyssa: Good call — we'll use "up to 30%" and a separate median stat in the blog. Closing thread unless issues.
